name: @neuropause/release
description: NeuroPause Enterprise Management System — Production Execution Program, Sprint 6: Version 1.0 General Availability, Enterprise Operations & Commercial Launch. An additive package that composes Waves 1-14 and Sprints 1-5, unchanged, into a complete release-engineering and operational-launch layer: a GA/release/version runtime with a governed release lifecycle; v1.0 packaging for Windows/macOS/Linux/Docker/Kubernetes/Helm/offline bundles (represented honestly with real descriptors + checksums; installers reuse the production installer); release-candidate validation (reusing the Sprint-4 reliability end-to-end validation + readiness scoring); an evidence-based GA gate (Go/No-Go + a REAL executive approver, never fabricated); production release management (scheduling, promotion, rollback plans, hotfix/patch/LTS registries, release notes); a customer-operations platform (registry/health/deployment+license inventory/usage/renewal — reusing the commercial platform); support operations (portal/tickets/escalation/incidents/RCA/knowledge-base — reusing operations); customer-success operations (health/adoption/renewal/expansion — never fabricating metrics); enterprise documentation (11 guides); release automation (packaging/signing/artifact-validation/promotion/verification); marketplace & distribution adapters (GitHub Releases/private enterprise repos/Azure/AWS marketplaces/Docker registry — never claimed live unless published); license management (Trial/Community/Professional/Enterprise — reusing commercial); operational monitoring + business analytics (real data only); governance; production-operations playbooks; and an executive dashboard (live metrics only where available). Release/version/packaging/automation/license runtimes, documentation, governance, and operations are LIVE-VERIFIED; GitHub Releases/Azure/AWS marketplaces/Docker registry/enterprise repositories are ADAPTER-VERIFIED; customer growth/revenue/renewals/adoption/expansion/production usage are BUSINESS-DATA-PENDING; and external marketplace publication/customer production environments/regional deployments/CDN distribution are INFRASTRUCTURE-PENDING. No marketplace publication, customer growth, revenue, or compliance certification is claimed before it occurs; executive approvals are never fabricated; and every release decision is evidence-based and audited on the one chain with a replay id.
